_comment: Dashboard/website branding config. Copy this, rename it (e.g. campaign.json), keep only the keys you want to change, then pass it to bfdb.
_note: Served at GET /api/config and deep-merged over the built-in defaults (bfweb/src/config/campaign.ts) at runtime. Every key is optional. The values below ARE the current defaults -- override what you need. This file only styles bfweb (the dashboard); bfsite (the public site) and bfwiki carry their own copy, and the engine (gameplay) config is a separate file -- see _engine_note.
name: Vector Strike
tagline: Where every sortie shapes the war.
_logo_note: logoUrl: URL or path to a logo image (shown in the sidebar). Empty = text monogram.
_serverip_note: serverIp: 'host:port' shown in the topbar so pilots can direct-connect. Empty = hidden.
_wiki_note: wikiUrl: link to the wiki (opens the WIKI item in the sidebar). Empty = hidden.
_donation_note: donationUrl: Ko-fi / Patreon / etc. Empty = the SUPPORT button is hidden.
_color_note: CSS colour strings. Omit any key to keep the default. accent* drive the OD-green UI accent; blue/red are the coalition colours; bg* are the dark-theme surfaces (the light theme has its own fixed palette).
_bg_image_note: backgroundImage: URL (HTTPS or relative path) to an image drawn faintly behind the whole UI. Empty = none.
_camo_note: camoPattern: built-in CSS overlay pattern. 'none' | 'digital' | 'hex' | 'terrain' | 'multicam'. Renders on top of backgroundImage if both are set.
_map_note: mapCenter [lat, lon] / mapZoom only position the SITREP page's mini-map. The TACMAP page auto-detects the DCS theatre from the campaign objectives. Preset centres: Caucasus [42.35,43.50], Syria [35.0,38.5], Persia [26.5,55.5], Sinai [31.0,32.0], Kola [67.6,25.6], Nevada [36.7,-115.6], Normandy [49.0,-0.5].
_tacmap_note: TACMAP is a server-authoritative fog-of-war picture over WS /ws/tacmap: each coalition only sees what its own sensors detect, streamed per side from the engine's query-tacmap RPC. Nothing to set here. AIR contacts = the EWR/AWACS network + friendly airborne datalink (automatic). GROUND contacts (JTAC eyes-on, recon/ELINT) only appear if the ENGINE config has an `elint` and/or `player_recon` block -- with neither, the ground picture is always empty. /ws/units and /api/units (raw god's-eye feed) are admin-only.
_dashboard_legacy_note: dashboardRightPanelWidth / dashboardObjectivesHeight are read but unused by the current dashboard layout; kept for back-compat.
_srs_note: srsUrl: an http(s) URL to proxy (SRS's own HTTP_SERVER feature) OR a local path to the JSON file SRS writes when CLIENT_EXPORT_ENABLED=True. Empty = the SRS radio panel is hidden. --srs-url on the bfdb command line overrides this.
_gci_note: Live GCI (proactive AWACS-style SRS callouts over two persistent SRS connections) has its OWN file -- see gci.sample.json in the repo root, wired via --gci-config (or $gciConfigPath in bfsystem.ps1). A `gci` object may be placed here as a fallback (same keys as gci.sample.json) but --gci-config wins.
_engine_note: Gameplay/engine config (objectives, deployables, EWR, elint, player_recon, logistics, ...) is a SEPARATE file loaded by bflib, editable in-dashboard when bfdb is started with --engine-config <path> (e.g. miz/ODFv2_CFG). It is NOT this file.
_credits_note: engineCredits show on the ABOUT page as the Fowl Engine authors; serverCredits as the people running this server.
